# Tooth Haven Multispeciality Dental Care

> Multispeciality dental clinic in West Mambalam, Chennai, led by Dr. Karthik Srinivasan. Offers full-spectrum dental care including a "Smile on the Go" home-visit service for elderly and mobility-restricted patients.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Clinic overview, services, doctor profile, testimonials, and appointment booking.
- [Patient Portal](/patient-portal): Phone-based patient login to view appointment history, treatment plans, investigations (including CBCT viewer), and clinic updates.
